profile.headline: Software Engineer at Lira Technologies LLC
profile.summary:
Hi! I'm Kaylyn, recent Cornell CS grad and full-stack engineer. Currently working as a software engineer @ Lira Tech. 

Contact me at hyunkale@gmail.com.

positions.title: Full-Stack Platform Engineer
positions.description:
- Built the TEIM full-stack platform as sole platform engineer using React/Vite, Fastify/Node.js, PostgreSQL, Docker, and AWS/Terraform for a B2B pilot.
- Designed and implemented end-to-end backend architecture, including REST APIs, SQL migrations, owner-scoped access control, rate limiting, and OAuth authentication.
- Engineered integration boundaries for external AI assistants and economic model engines with versioned contracts and adapter switching.
- Hardened production security and reliability via encrypted document uploads, presigned URLs, GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, and secret scanning.

positions.title: Full-Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
- Architected, built, and launched rayreveal.com end-to-end as sole developer and designer.
- Implemented a modern design system using Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, optimizing for core web vitals, dynamic project routing, and technical SEO.
- Applied web performance standards and security hardening to ensure ultra-fast load times and seamless cross-device compatibility.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Developed an end-to-end ML data pipeline in Cornell Engineering’s Napp Lab: dataset prep/labeling → YOLO model training/inference → structured outputs (e.g., sticker IDs + direction) for scalable bee behavior analysis.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Built and optimized the Scores to Schools website (solo) and end-to-end on Squarespace, restructuring site architecture and navigation, creating service/program pages, improving pricing and conversion flow, implementing technical SEO (alt text, metadata) and Google Search Console, and adding custom CSS/template tweaks with maintenance across desktop/mobile.

positions.locationName: Queens, New York, United States · On-site
